FAQ

AI agents, explained.

What is an AI agent for business?

An AI agent is software that talks to your customers for you. It replies to messages and calls, answers questions from your own information, books appointments and sends qualified leads to your team, 24 hours a day.

How is a DigiPromise agent different from a normal chatbot?

A normal chatbot follows fixed buttons and scripts. Our agents understand free-text questions in Arabic, English and 100+ languages, are trained on your business, take actions like bookings and are set up and managed for you.

Which agent is right for my business?

Pick the agent built for your industry: IRIS for real estate, AURA for ecommerce, Nova for restaurants and hotels, Luna for clinics, gyms and studios, Lara for car rental and Stella for phone calls. If you are not sure, book a call and we will recommend one.

Can I use more than one agent?

Yes. Many businesses combine a chat agent with Stella for phone calls. All your agents report into one client dashboard.

Do you set everything up?

Yes. We train the agent on your business, connect your channels, test it with you and keep improving it after launch. You do not need any technical skills.

How much do the agents cost?

Plans start from the prices shown on each agent card. Monthly plans have a one-time setup fee. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise.

Not sure which agent fits?

Book a free 30-minute call and we will recommend the right agent and plan for your business.
